## TRAIN: graph rarity v2

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# PURE GRAPH V2 ON SUPERMARKET

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

# BASIC BASKET DATA FOR PROFILE ONLY

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 1. DEGREE RARITY

dept_freq_tbl <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(department, name = "dept_freq") %>%
  mutate(
    dept_rarity = 1 / dept_freq
  )


dept_rarity_lookup <- dept_freq_tbl$dept_rarity
names(dept_rarity_lookup) <- dept_freq_tbl$department

# 2. EDGE COUNTS / EDGE SURPRISE

basket_depts <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(sort(unique(department))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

edge_counts <- map_dfr(basket_depts$departments, function(depts) {
  if (length(depts) < 2) {
    return(tibble(dept_a = integer(), dept_b = integer()))
  }
  pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
  tibble(
    dept_a = pairs[, 1],
    dept_b = pairs[, 2]
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_a, dept_b, name = "edge_n") %>%
  mutate(
    edge_commonness = edge_n / max(edge_n),
    edge_surprise = 1 - edge_commonness
  )


edge_lookup <- edge_counts %>%
  mutate(edge_key = paste(dept_a, dept_b, sep = "_"))

edge_commonness_lookup <- edge_lookup$edge_commonness
names(edge_commonness_lookup) <- edge_lookup$edge_key

edge_surprise_lookup <- edge_lookup$edge_surprise
names(edge_surprise_lookup) <- edge_lookup$edge_key

strong_edge_threshold <- quantile(edge_counts$edge_commonness, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# HELPERS

get_edge_keys <- function(depts) {
  if (length(depts) < 2) return(character(0))
  pairs <- t(combn(sort(unique(depts)), 2))
  paste(pairs[, 1], pairs[, 2], sep = "_")
}

calc_entropy_norm <- function(counts_vec) {
  probs <- counts_vec / sum(counts_vec)
  ent <- -sum(probs * log(probs))
  if (length(probs) <= 1) return(0)
  ent / log(length(probs))
}

calc_strong_triangle_share <- function(depts) {
  depts <- sort(unique(depts))
  if (length(depts) < 3) return(0)

  triples <- combn(depts, 3, simplify = FALSE)

  strong_flags <- map_lgl(triples, function(tri) {
    keys <- c(
      paste(tri[1], tri[2], sep = "_"),
      paste(tri[1], tri[3], sep = "_"),
      paste(tri[2], tri[3], sep = "_")
    )
    commonness_vals <- edge_commonness_lookup[keys]
    commonness_vals[is.na(commonness_vals)] <- 0
    all(commonness_vals >= strong_edge_threshold)
  })

  mean(strong_flags)
}

# GRAPH FEATURES PER BASKET

basket_graph_features <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(department),
    dept_item_counts = list(table(department)),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    unique_dept_vec = list(sort(unique(unlist(departments)))),

    avg_dept_rarity = mean(
      dept_rarity_lookup[as.character(unique_dept_vec)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    max_dept_rarity = max(
      dept_rarity_lookup[as.character(unique_dept_vec)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    edge_keys = list(get_edge_keys(unique_dept_vec)),

    mean_edge_commonness = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      mean(edge_commonness_lookup[edge_keys], na.rm = TRUE),
      1
    ),

    mean_edge_surprise = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      mean(edge_surprise_lookup[edge_keys], na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    ),

    max_edge_surprise = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      max(edge_surprise_lookup[edge_keys], na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    ),

    strong_edge_share = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      mean(edge_commonness_lookup[edge_keys] >= strong_edge_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
      1
    ),

    graph_entropy = calc_entropy_norm(as.numeric(dept_item_counts)),

    strong_triangle_share = calc_strong_triangle_share(unique_dept_vec)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    unique_departments,
    avg_dept_rarity,
    max_dept_rarity,
    mean_edge_commonness,
    mean_edge_surprise,
    max_edge_surprise,
    strong_edge_share,
    graph_entropy,
    strong_triangle_share
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    clique_surprise = 1 - strong_triangle_share,
    density_surprise = 1 - strong_edge_share
  )

# entropy should be judged relative to department count
entropy_model <- lm(graph_entropy ~ unique_departments, data = basket_graph_features)

basket_graph_features <- basket_graph_features %>%
  mutate(
    expected_graph_entropy = predict(entropy_model, newdata = .),
    entropy_deviation = abs(graph_entropy - expected_graph_entropy)
  )

# FINAL PURE GRAPH V2 SCORE

basket_graph_v2 <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(basket_graph_features, by = c("transaction_id", "unique_departments")) %>%
  mutate(
    graph_v2_score =
      0.20 * percent_rank(avg_dept_rarity) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_dept_rarity) +
      0.25 * percent_rank(mean_edge_surprise) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_edge_surprise) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(entropy_deviation) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(density_surprise) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(clique_surprise)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(graph_v2_score))

top_150_graph_v2_train <- basket_graph_v2 %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$avg_dept_rarity)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$mean_edge_surprise)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$entropy_deviation)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$density_surprise)
summary(top_150_graph_v2_train$clique_surprise)

write.csv(
  top_150_graph_v2_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_graph_v2_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
